project.title: Hybrid Customer Onboarding Workspace Rollout
project.objective: Design and roll out a standardized hybrid (online + in-office) customer onboarding workspace and process across the sales and project teams.
deliverables: Standardized hybrid onboarding workflow and RACI
Template set of onboarding documents and checklists
Shared digital workspace structure for onboarding projects
Training session and quick-start guide for internal teams
Pilot onboarding report with KPIs and lessons learned
constraints: Go-live for first pilot customer within 21 days
Must use existing office productivity and CRM tools
Process must comply with internal legal and data protection rules
Minimal disruption to ongoing customer projects
Solution must be usable by both office-based and remote staff

risks.risk: Onboarding workflow becomes too complex and slows down sales cycles.
risks.mitigation: Run a pilot with one customer, collect cycle-time metrics, and simplify steps before full rollout.

risks.risk: Staff do not adopt the new workspace structure and keep using ad-hoc tools.
risks.mitigation: Involve key users in design, provide short trainings, and define clear usage rules in guidelines.

risks.risk: Process or templates miss key legal or data protection requirements.
risks.mitigation: Early review of templates by legal and compliance before pilot launch.

risks.risk: Existing tools lack needed features for collaboration and tracking.
risks.mitigation: Align design with current tool capabilities and define simple workarounds where needed.

themes.why_relevant: Core to reducing variability and errors across customer projects.
Ensures everyone knows where to find and store onboarding information.
Sales, projects, and office operations must align on handovers and responsibilities.
Onboarding materials must meet legal and internal policy requirements.
Staff need clear guidance to adopt the new process quickly.

backlog.task: Map current customer onboarding steps across sales and project teams
definition_of_done: Interviews with at least 3 recent project owners completed
End-to-end as-is process documented with swimlane view
Pain points and duplicate steps listed and shared

backlog.task: Design target hybrid onboarding workflow and RACI
definition_of_done: To-be workflow diagram created and stored in shared workspace
RACI matrix agreed for each major step
Workflow reviewed and approved by sales management and PMO

backlog.task: Draft standardized onboarding document and email templates
definition_of_done: Set of document and email templates created in office suite
Templates checked for formatting and clarity
Version-controlled folder created and shared with project managers

backlog.task: Review onboarding templates for legal and data protection compliance
definition_of_done: Templates sent to legal and compliance for review
Feedback incorporated and tracked
Final sign-off from legal and compliance recorded

backlog.task: Define structure of the shared digital onboarding workspace
definition_of_done: Folder and channel structure proposed and documented
Naming conventions and access rules defined
Structure validated with IT support for feasibility

backlog.task: Configure pilot onboarding workspace for first customer
definition_of_done: Workspace created following agreed structure
Customer-specific folders and checklists prepared
Access granted to all internal stakeholders involved in pilot

backlog.task: Create onboarding checklists for internal teams
definition_of_done: Separate checklists for sales, project, and customer success drafted
Checklists aligned with target workflow steps
Checklists uploaded to shared workspace and linked in guidelines

backlog.task: Develop quick-start guideline for staff using the new process
definition_of_done: Guideline document created with screenshots and examples
Includes do/don't and escalation paths
Reviewed by at least two project managers and updated

backlog.task: Plan and deliver internal training session on new onboarding process
definition_of_done: Training agenda and materials prepared
At least one live or recorded session delivered
Attendance or view metrics captured and shared

backlog.task: Run pilot onboarding using new workspace and collect feedback
definition_of_done: Pilot customer selected and confirmed
Onboarding executed fully using new process
Feedback from internal team and customer captured in report

backlog.task: Consolidate pilot learnings and update workflow and templates
definition_of_done: Pilot report analyzed and key issues prioritized
Updated versions of workflow and templates published
Change log shared in channel and archived

backlog.task: Set up basic tracking sheet for onboarding KPIs
definition_of_done: Sheet created with agreed KPIs (cycle time, errors, rework)
Columns and data entry rules documented
Shared with project managers and linked in workspace

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, success criteria, and initial backlog for the onboarding rollout.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the hybrid onboarding workspace project.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on project scope boundaries and what is out of scope for this rollout.
Confirm initial success metrics and which KPIs will be tracked in the sheet.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and finalize the target onboarding workflow, RACI, and workspace structure.
threads_plan.trigger: Share first draft of the to-be workflow and workspace proposal for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the target onboarding workflow and RACI for pilot use.
Agree on the standard workspace structure and naming conventions.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Create and validate templates, checklists, and compliance aspects.
threads_plan.trigger: Post initial versions of templates and checklists for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on the standard onboarding templates for internal and customer use.
Confirm that legal and data protection requirements are fully covered.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and coordinate the pilot onboarding execution and training.
threads_plan.trigger: Identify first pilot customer and propose pilot timeline.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the pilot customer and agree on the pilot onboarding start date.
Decide training format (live vs recorded) and schedule for internal teams.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results, adjust process, and agree on rollout plan.
threads_plan.trigger: Share pilot onboarding summary report and KPI snapshot.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on key changes to workflow and templates based on pilot learnings.
Decide go/no-go and timing for broader rollout of the new onboarding process.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in: each member posts yesterday/today/risks in the morning.
Twice-weekly design huddle thread focused on workflow and workspace questions.
Weekly pilot status update summarizing progress, KPIs, and blockers.
Post-pilot retrospective thread to capture what worked and what to change.
Template and guideline change log posts whenever A2, A3, or A5 are updated.
